description: Apply the machine-applicable fixes attached to a plan's compile diagnostics and return the edited source. It corrects source-level faults (an opening off its wall becomes the attachment form, an out-of-range position is clamped, …); furniture geometry is `repair`'s job. It runs at most 4 passes and rolls back a pass that raises the error count. `unsafe:true` also applies `maybe-incorrect` fixes. Returns { ok, passes, applied, skipped, source }.
name: fix
title: Apply machine-applicable diagnostic fixes
